stem.en: Comparing the oxoacids of chlorine — hypochlorous acid (HClO) and perchloric acid (HClO4) — which is the stronger acid, and why?
stem.et: Võrreldes kloori hapnikhappeid — hüpokloorishapet (HClO) ja perkloorhapet (HClO4) — kumb on tugevam hape ja miks?

label.en: Perchloric acid, because chlorine is in a higher oxidation state with more oxygen atoms pulling electron density away from the O-H bond
label.et: Perkloorhape, kuna kloor on kõrgemas oksüdatsiooniastmes ja rohkem hapnikuaatomeid tõmbab elektrontihedust O-H sidemest eemale

label.en: Hypochlorous acid, because fewer oxygen atoms make the O-H bond stronger and easier to release as a proton
label.et: Hüpokloorishape, kuna vähem hapnikuaatomeid muudab O-H sideme tugevamaks ja prootonina kergemini vabastatavaks

label.en: Both acids are equally strong, since they contain the same central atom
label.et: Mõlemad happed on võrdselt tugevad, kuna neil on sama tsentraalne aatom

label.en: Acid strength cannot be compared between different oxoacids of the same element
label.et: Happe tugevust ei saa võrrelda sama elemendi erinevate hapnikhapete vahel
